title: O*NET 31.0-derived career-search intent hypotheses
methodology: This record contains query hypotheses built from distinct O*NET 31.0 occupational job-title strings. It is a candidate phrase inventory for career-search content planning, not a keyword-tool export, not an observed search-query dataset, and not evidence of monthly search volume. Each phrase retains the source occupation title, associated O*NET-SOC code(s), and a transparent phrase-construction rule. Keyword demand and KOV service relevance require separate validation.
